name: @psyb0t/mt5-httpapi
summary: Wire an OpenClaw agent to a self-hosted mt5-httpapi MetaTrader 5 bridge over MCP — typed tools for terminals, market data, orders, positions, history, and backtests.
description: A thin stdio<->HTTP bridge that connects an MCP client (OpenClaw, Claude, Cursor, Codex, ...) to a running mt5-httpapi MCP endpoint (/mcp). The server exposes dedicated typed tools for terminal health and control, account data, symbols, rates, ticks, technical analysis, orders, positions, history, and backtest status, plus endpoints and request fallbacks for JSON-compatible REST routes; multipart backtest submission still uses REST directly. Point the bridge at the server root for broker/account parameters across every configured terminal, or at one terminal path to pin the session. mt5-httpapi is self-hosted; order and position mutations are real actions on a live trading account. See https://github.com/psyb0t/mt5-httpapi.

MT5_API_URL.description: Base URL of your running mt5-httpapi (the bridge appends /mcp/). The server root, e.g. http://localhost:8888, bridges to every terminal with broker/account tool parameters; a terminal path, e.g. http://localhost:8888/<broker>/<account>, pins the bridge to one terminal.

MT5_API_TOKEN.description: Bearer token — required whenever the server's api_token is set (same token as the REST API); omit only if the server has auth disabled.

url.description: Base URL of your running mt5-httpapi (the bridge appends /mcp/). The server root, e.g. http://localhost:8888, bridges to every terminal with broker/account tool parameters; a terminal path, e.g. http://localhost:8888/<broker>/<account>, pins the bridge to one terminal.

token.description: Bearer token — required whenever the server's api_token is set (same token as the REST API); omit only if the server has auth disabled.
